run: Xvfb :99 1280x1024x24, SDL_VIDEO_DRIVER=x11, SDL_AUDIO_DRIVER=dummy, NTSDSDL cross-built for glibc aarch64 with FreeType text; real time (no --virtual-clock), no --script: input only from xdotool (XTEST)

open: a window manager's decorations and SM_CYCAPTION on X11 (metrics are 0 here; the game derives the client size, so only the outer size differs)
